## Checklist

- [ ] I opened or referenced the related issue when applicable.
- [ ] The pull request is focused on a single topic.
- [ ] I updated documentation when behavior or setup changed.
- [ ] I ran the relevant checks for the changed package.
- [ ] I did not include secrets or private data.
- [ ] I prepared a Conventional Commits title and description for squash & merge.
